images.alt: A wide, shallow river with sand banks under a cloudy sky
images.caption: The Mitchell River in the dry season: a wide sandy bed with permanent pools. This photo is from far downstream at the Koolatah–Dunbar crossing; up near Karma Waters the river is narrower, with paperbark-lined banks.
images.credit: Photo: Tennis expert, via Wikimedia Commons
images.location: Koolatah–Dunbar crossing, Mitchell River, Cape York Peninsula

images.alt: A roadside township with a pub and old machinery under a blue sky
images.caption: Mount Carbine, the nearest township to Karma Waters, on the Peninsula Developmental Road.
images.credit: Photo: Bruceanthro at English Wikipedia, via Wikimedia Commons

images.alt: A black-and-white view over a mining township and bare hills
images.caption: Mount Carbine in about 1911, seen from its hill of wolfram (tungsten) workings. Mining reshaped this country from the late 1800s.
images.credit: Photo: State Library of Queensland, via Wikimedia Commons
